scoring_justification: Peak location is recomputed from the raw CSV profile and compared to the paper-reported 1 % BZ with tolerance; no external ground truth file needed.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden tolerance for peak location and intensity
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 1 and text: persistent feature at ~1 % BZ, length scale 250±25 Å; peak intensity visible relative to main beam but reduced; we require intensity ≥0.1 after normalization.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper description; tolerance of ±0.15 % BZ accounts for resolution and implementation spread; intensity floor 0.1 ensures a distinct feature.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Based on explicit statements in the paper (1 % BZ, position independent of temperature, peak distinct enough to be observed).

outputs.description: Simulated SPA-LEED diffraction intensity profile that must exhibit a clear peak near 1% Brillouin Zone.

output_contract.notes: The physical target is the peak location at approximately 1% BZ. The hidden checker will verify the peak position and a minimum intensity threshold; agents must genuinely run the FK energy minimization and diffraction calculation to produce a correct profile.
